description: List a Cloud for WordPress site's backups, newest first: automatic file backups daily and database backups hourly, kept 30 days, plus up to one on-demand backup of each type. Returns the newest `limit` (default 100; on-demand ones always included) and the `total`. Each has an `id` for restore_wordpress_backup (one files id + one database id) or delete_wordpress_backup.

domain.description: Domain of the Cloud for WordPress site, e.g. `example.com`.

staging.description: true: act on the site's staging copy instead of the live site.

name: list_wordpress_backups
title: List Wordpress Backups
